comments.body: I did my Master’s thesis there and unfortunately the only ´perks’ I got were 3 free food vouchers. You can basically take as much food as you can fit on your tray each time. Other than that, not even coffee is free - the cheapest place to get it is at the canteen for 1 CHF. There are several other vending machines around the campus selling overpriced coffee and food.
comments.author: SnooGuavas6832
